title: Solidity Quiz
description: Review the 12 starter lessons. The questions name the example to revisit. Take your time, use the lessons, and read the reason after each answer.

questions.question: A contract groups functions and data. Call message() to read a greeting without changing stored data. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: message is pure, so it reads no stored state. Calling it returns the string literal. Use the practice VM; no wallet or real money is needed.

questions.question: uint256 stores a nonnegative whole number. Call answer() to add two small counts. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The pure function adds two uint256 values and returns 5. Unsigned numbers cannot represent negative values.

questions.question: A state variable lives in contract storage. public creates a getter. Call score(). What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The public variable creates an automatic getter. A fresh VM deployment starts it at 3. Changing source code does not change a contract already deployed.

questions.question: A parameter is an input value. Call twice(4) in Remix. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The input n is 4. The function returns its product with 2. Very large products can overflow and revert in Solidity 0.8.

questions.question: if selects a result based on a rule. Call message(8). What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The input 8 passes the rule, so the first return sends Pass. Specify memory for this returned string.

questions.question: A memory array is temporary data for the call. Call answer() to read its second item. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The memory array has two positions. Position 1 is filled with 8 and then returned. An index outside the array reverts the call.

questions.question: A for loop repeats steps. Call answer() to add 1, 2 and 3. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The total begins at zero. The loop adds 1, 2 and 3. Unbounded loops can use too much gas in real transactions.

questions.question: An enum names a small set of choices. Call answer() to read the chosen case number. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: Enum numbers start at zero. Green is the second case and converts to 1. Enum case numbers start at zero.

questions.question: A struct groups related fields. Call answer() to read a book page count. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The memory struct stores 24 in pages. The returned field is that number. Choose memory for a temporary struct used only inside a call.

questions.question: A mapping pairs keys with values. Unset integer keys return zero. Call scoreOf(1). What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: No entry was written for key 1. The uint256 default is zero. A zero result does not tell you whether a key was ever written.

questions.question: require stops a call when its rule is false. Call check(0) to see the error. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The input zero fails amount > 0. require reverts with the given reason. A reverted call does not keep its state changes.

questions.question: view allows reading contract state. Call doubled() to read twice the stored score. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The view function reads stored score 4 and returns 8 without changing it. pure cannot read state; use view when state is needed.
